title: Register the mine as an establishment
due_rule: within sixty days from the date the Code applies
citation_quote: shall, within sixty days from the date of such applicability of this Code, make an application electronically to the registering officer appointed by the appropriate Government
note: The application form (FORM-I, Shram Suvidha Portal) is in OSH (Central) Rules r.3(1).

title: Prior notice of commencement, reopening, cessation or closure of a mine
due_rule: not less than thirty days before
citation_quote: in the case of mines, the employer of every mine shall give not less than thirty days’ prior notice of the commencement, reopening, cessation, discontinuation or abandonment of operations or closing of mines in FORM- VII
note: Printed as a proviso after sub-rule (2); the sub-rule label is inferred.

title: Notify a fatal accident
due_rule: forthwith
citation_quote: an accident occurs resulting to death, the employer of the establishment shall inform to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator forthwith in a notice in FORM-XI
note: The rule also requires notice to the District Magistrate/SDO, the police and the victim's family.

title: Report an injury that disables for 48 hours or more
due_rule: within twelve hours after the completion of forty-eight hours
citation_quote: FORM-XI within twelve hours after the completion of forty-eight hours, electronically to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator(s).

title: Notify a dangerous occurrence
due_rule: within twelve hours
evidence_type: intimation to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator and DM/SDO
citation_quote: dangerous occurrence as specified in sub-rule (4), whether causing any bodily injury or disability or not, the employer shall within twelve hours send an intimation to- (i) the Inspector-cum-Facilitator
note: r.7(4) lists the classes, including mine-specific ones (inrush of water, fire, explosion).

title: Safety committee meets at least monthly
due_rule: at least once a month; committee tenure three years
citation_quote: The tenure of the Safety Committee shall be for three years and it shall meet at least once in every quarter. Provided that in the case of mines, the Safety Committee shall meet at least once in a month.
note: r.14(1): required where 500 or more workers are employed.

title: Appoint safety officers where 100 or more workers are employed
due_rule: one safety officer up to five hundred workers
citation_quote: At every mine, wherein one hundred or more workers are ordinarily employed, the employer shall appoint safety officer on a scale of one up to five hundred workers
note: One more for each further 500 workers or part thereof.

title: Quarterly emergency mock drills
due_rule: quarterly
citation_quote: shall ensure quarterly conduct of Mock drills to check emergency preparedness to deal with various emergencies.
note: The form of record is not stated.

title: Initial and annual medical examination of mine workers
due_rule: initial examination before employment; periodical examination annually
citation_quote: The employer of every mine shall make arrangements for – (i) initial medical examination of every person seeking employment in a mine; (ii) periodical medical examination of person employed in a mine annually;
note: r.60(i) extends medical examination duties to contract labour.

title: Keep medical examination records for five years after employment
due_rule: while employed and for five years thereafter
citation_quote: shall be retained in the possession of the manager of the mine so long as the person is employed in the mine and for a period of five years thereafter

title: Upload the annual return
due_rule: on or before 28/29 February following each calendar year
citation_quote: on or before the 28th or 29th day of February following the end of each Calendar year, upload a return in FORM-XVII and XVIII on the designated portal
note: r.74 also requires FORM-XVII to reach the Inspector-cum-Facilitator by the last day of February.

title: Keep registers and preserve them for five years
due_rule: preserve for five calendar years from the last entry
citation_quote: all the registers and other records shall be preserved in original for a period of five calendar years from the date of last entry made therein.
note: Employee register, attendance-cum-muster roll and wage register: r.72(1)(i)-(iii).

title: Contractor licence is valid for five years
due_rule: valid for five years
citation_quote: the licence issued for the purposes of sub-section (1) of section 47 shall be valid for a period of five years in respect of the number of contract labour specified therein
note: Under r.90(4), no licence is needed for up to 49 contract labour.

title: Apply for contractor licence renewal in time
due_rule: at least 30 days, and not more than 90 days, before expiry
citation_quote: Every such application shall be submitted on the Portal referred to in sub-rule (1) at least thirty days prior to expiry of licence period but not before ninety days of such expiry of licence.
note: r.91(3): a late application attracts 25% extra fee.

title: Intimate each contract work order
due_rule: within fifteen days of receiving the work order
citation_quote: Every contractor shall within fifteen days of the receipt of a contract work order shall intimate about the contract work order

title: Pay contract labour wages by the seventh day
due_rule: before the expiry of the seventh day after the last day of the wage period
citation_quote: The wages of every person employed as contract labour in an establishment or by a contractor shall be paid before the expiry of seventh day after the last day of the wage period

title: Contractor half-yearly return
due_rule: within thirty days of the close of each half year
citation_quote: Every contractor shall send half-yearly return in FORM-XVIII electronically to the Deputy Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) concerned not later than thirty days from the close of the half year

title: Refresher training at least once in four years
due_rule: at least once in four years
citation_quote: Every person in employment in a mine shall undergo the refresher training at least once in four years, as per training scheme
note: r.158: initial training before employment; r.162: retraining after long absence, a serious accident or a job change.

title: Report unsafe or unhealthy situations
due_rule: as soon as practicable
citation_quote: if any situation which is unsafe or unhealthy comes to his attention, as soon as practicable, report such situation to his employer or to the health and safety representative

title: Consent of the State Board for water discharges (Water Act)
instrument: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974
frequency: once; renewed as the consent order states
due_rule: before establishing the operation or a new discharge; valid for the period in the consent order
citation_quote: no person shall, without the previous consent of the State Board, — (a) establish or take any steps to establish any industry, operation or process, or any treatment and disposal system
note: Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Consent of the State Board to operate in an air pollution control area (Air Act)
instrument: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1981
frequency: once; renewed as the consent order states
due_rule: before establishing or operating; valid for the period in the consent order
citation_quote: no person shall, without the previous consent of the State Board, establish or operate any industrial plant in an air pollution control area
note: Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Annual environmental statement (Form V)
due_rule: on or before 30 September, for the financial year ending 31 March
citation_quote: shall submit an environmental 1 [statement] for the financial year ending the 31st March in Form V to the concerned State Pollution Control Board on or before the 1 [thirtieth day of September] every year
note: '1 [' marks are amendment references printed in the text. Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Ambient air limits for coal mines, 500 m downwind of dust sources
clause: Sch. I, entry 90 (Standards for Coal Mines), para 1
due_rule: new mines, 24 h: RPM 250, SO2 120, NOx 120 µg/m3 (Tables II-III give other values for existing coalfields)
citation_quote: (RPM) Annual Average* 24 Hours ** 180 µg/m3 250 µg/m3 Respirable Particulate Matter sampling and analysis Sulphur Dioxide (SO2) Annual Average* 24 Hours ** 80 µg/m3 120 µg/m3
note: Table columns are flattened in the text. Jharia, Raniganj and Bokaro have their own table. Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Air quality monitoring at a coal mine every fortnight
due_rule: once in a fortnight at the dust generating sources
citation_quote: Air Quality monitoring at a frequency of once in a fortnight at the dust generating sources given in clause 1 shall be carried out.
note: Relaxation and escalation rules follow on the same pages. Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Mine effluent discharge limits
due_rule: pH 5.5-9.0; COD 250 mg/l; TSS 100 mg/l (200 on land for irrigation); oil and grease 10 mg/l
citation_quote: pH - 5.5 to 9.0 Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) - 250 mg/l Total Suspended Solids (TSS) - 100 mg/l, 200 mg/l (Land for irrigation) Oil & Grease (O & G) - 10 mg/l
note: Monitoring once in a fortnight (same page). Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Mine noise limits
due_rule: Leq 75 dB(A) 6 am-10 pm; Leq 70 dB(A) 10 pm-6 am; monitored once a fortnight
citation_quote: 2. Noise Level Standards 6.00 AM – 10.00 PM 10.00 PM – 6.00 AM Noise level Leq 75 dB(A) Leq 70 dB(A) (Monitoring frequency for noise level shall be once in a fortnight)
note: Printed as para '2.' after para 3. Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: National ambient air quality standards (PM10, PM2.5, SO2, NO2)
due_rule: 24 h: PM10 100, PM2.5 60, SO2 80, NO2 80 µg/m3 (industrial/residential areas)
citation_quote: 3 Particulate Matter (size less than 10µm) or PM10 µg/m3 Annual* 24 hours** 60 100 60 100 - Gravimetric - TOEM - Beta attenuation 4 Particulate Matter (size less than 2.5µm) or PM2.5 µg/m3 Annual* 40 40
note: Applies at a coal mine where a residential, commercial or industrial place is within 500 m of a dust source (Sch. I entry 90). Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Report an accidental discharge or emission above standards
due_rule: forthwith
responsible_role: person in charge of the place
citation_quote: the person in charge of the place at which such discharge occurs or is apprehended to occur shall forth with intimate the fact of such occurrence or apprehension of such occurrence
note: Text as printed in the CPCB Pollution Control Law Series, 7th ed. (2021); later amendments not reflected.

title: Keep mine plans and sections up to date
due_rule: corrected up to a date not earlier than three months
citation_quote: (4) The plans and sections required by these regulations shall be maintained corrected up-to-date which is not earlier than three months
note: Plans must also be brought up to date before abandonment or closure (proviso).

title: Weekly examination of winding ropes
due_rule: at least once every seven days, at no more than 1 m/s
evidence_type: examination report in bound paged book
citation_quote: (b) once at least in every seven days, – (i) each winding rope by passing the rope at a speed not exceeding one meter per second;
note: reg.88(1) also sets 24-hour, 30-day and 12-month checks.

title: Sirdar inspection before and during each shift
due_rule: within two hours before work starts, then at least every four hours
evidence_type: inspection report in bound paged book
citation_quote: shall, within two hours before the commencement of work in a shift, inspect every part of the mine or district assigned to him, in which persons have to work or pass during the shift
note: The four-hour repeat is later in the same sub-regulation; reg.129(8) requires the bound paged book.

title: Carbon monoxide testing of depillaring districts
due_rule: CO tested at least every seven days; full analysis at least every thirty days
evidence_type: gas test record in bound paged book
citation_quote: (a) tested for percentage of carbon monoxide once at least in every seven days with an automatic detector of a type approved by the Chief Inspector; and (b) completely analysed once at least in every thirty days

title: Monthly examination of fire-fighting equipment
due_rule: at least once every month
evidence_type: examination report in bound paged book
citation_quote: (6) A competent person shall, once at least in every month, examine all the equipment, material and arrangements provided for fire-fighting

title: Monthly airborne respirable dust sampling
due_rule: at least once every month, or when the Regional Inspector orders
citation_quote: once at least in every month thereafter or whenever the Regional Inspector so requires by an order in writing, cause the air at every work place where airborne dust is generated, to be sampled

title: Respirable dust limit: 2 mg/m3 (8-hour average)
due_rule: 8-hour TWA not above 2 mg/m3 in coal (free silica below 5%); otherwise 10 / free silica %
citation_quote: in milligrams per cubic meter of air sampled by dust sampler of a type approved by and determined in accordance with the procedure as specified by the Chief Inspector by a general or special order, exceeds two
note: The silica condition and the 10/silica formula follow on the same page. Threshold source for D4 sensors.

title: Inflammable gas limits: 0.75% in return air, 1.25% anywhere
due_rule: 0.75% in the return air of a district; 1.25% in any place
evidence_type: air sample results in bound paged book
citation_quote: (c) the percentage of inflammable gas does not exceed 0.75 in the general body of the return air of any ventilating district and 1.25 in any place in the mine;
note: reg.153(2)(e): air samples at least every thirty days. Threshold source for D4 sensors.

title: Wet bulb temperature limit: 33.5 °C
due_rule: not above 33.5 °C; above 30.5 °C air must move at least 1 m/s
evidence_type: temperature readings in bound paged book
citation_quote: (d) the wet bulb temperature in any working place does not exceed 33.5 degrees centigrade, and where the wet bulb temperature exceeds 30.5 degrees centigrade
note: Threshold source for D4 sensors.

title: Weekly inflammable gas check where electricity is used
due_rule: at least every seven days; every 24 hours while above 0.8%
evidence_type: gas test record in bound paged book
citation_quote: (c) the determination shall be made or samples of air taken, as the case may be, once at least in every seven days, so however that – (i) if any determination shows the percentage of inflammable gas to exceed 0.8
note: reg.169(1)(e): above 1.25%, cut off power in the district and report to the Regional Inspector forthwith.

title: Supply protective footwear at least every six months
due_rule: free of charge, at intervals not exceeding six months
citation_quote: (2) The protective footwear referred to in sub-regulation (1) shall be supplied free of charge, at intervals not exceeding six months, by the owner, agent or manager of a mine
note: reg.241: approved helmets; reg.243: self-rescuers - no interval stated for either.

title: Monthly coal production return
due_rule: TODO-VERIFY
note: No downloaded source states a coal production reporting duty. The Ministry of Coal statistics (S06) are the published result of such returns, not the rule requiring them.
